article.story: AKRON, Ohio -- — Amani Lyles scored 24 points as Akron beat Bucknell 97-77 on Wednesday night. Tavari Johnson scored 23 points and added five assists for the Zips (7-2). Evan Mahaffey had 10 points. Quin Berger led the way for the Bison (2-8) with 18 points. Bucknell got 15 points and six rebounds from Aleksander Pachucki. Jayden Williams also had 15 points and five assists. The loss is the eighth in a row for the Bison. The Zips led 49-36 at halftime, with Lyles racking up 10 points. Akron pulled away with a 13-0 run in the second half to extend a seven-point lead to 20 points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
